name: Historic Centre of Oporto, Luiz I Bridge and Monastery of Serra do Pilar
description: Porto climbs the steep hillsides above the mouth of the Douro in northern Portugal, a tangle of old streets and tiled façades with roughly 2,000 years of history. Its monuments range from a cathedral with a Romanesque choir to the neoclassical Stock Exchange and the Manueline Church of Santa Clara. Across the river, the Serra do Pilar monastery, with its circular church and cloister, looks back over the city and the Luiz I Bridge.
